title: EZ Transaction Solution (EZTS)
description:
As the cross-chain ecosystem continues to expand, it has inadvertently led to a reduction in user experience, posing challenges in the seamless onboarding of individuals to the Web3 Ecosystem.

During a transaction, it is essential to know the specific details, 
- What asset do you want to receive
- On what chain do you want to receive
- to which address you want to recieve

But, without proper details , it would end up resulting in causing inconvenience or at worst can also make you loose your funds.

There is a rising concern of Bots and scamming in Web3 Payments and the bad Ux leads to reduction in user experience.

We introduce EZ Transaction Solution (EZTS).
It is a software (Web App ) , meant to make the whole process/transaction simple and easing the process ( Clearing any sort of confusion ) for both the sender and especially for the reciever.

With help of Anon Aadhar , the KYC verification is done increasing the security, Prevents spams and scams by limiting a person to use only a single wallet addrress.

And to make the seamless transaction experience and making it more easy to onboard new users, the traditional sign in with email is now replaced with Create & Sign in with Email , Phone Number or Google Signin.

Wallet Configuration would help bring the decision power to the reciever , 
Reciever can configure their preferance for :

- What asset do they want to receive
- On what chain do they want to receive
- Select Prefered Wallet Address. Can attest all your older wallets , and that would result in if any tokens were sent to an inactive wallet .

The core innovation lies in Wallet Configuration, allowing receivers to dictate their preferences and attest older wallets for added security against inactive addresses
